about_item: HURRICANE TABLE LAMP – Standing at 28cm tall, this antique-look bedside lamp includes a glass shade and brass effect base. Simply tap the lamp base to activate its dimmable function and instantly add a warm glow to any room.

TRADITIONAL LOOK – The lamp has an attractive, traditional look that will complement a wide variety of interior styles. It’s ideal for use as a bedside lamp but could also be used in living rooms, conservatories, and home offices.

3 BRIGHTNESS SETTINGS – This dimmable bedside lamp offers three levels of brightness - low, medium, and high. To switch between them, touch the lamp base to control the brightness to suit your preference. The fourth tap will turn the light off.
MAINS POWERED – The lamp is mains powered with a 1.5m cable and requires 1 x E14 40W Bulb (not included) which easily screws into place.
ANIKA LIGHTING – Anika is the leading manufacturer of homeware, bathroom, and kitchen essentials. View the Anika store on Amazon to view the whole range today.

summary.text: Customers find the hurricane lamp to be of good quality, with a decorative acrylic feature that doesn't try to be showy, and appreciate its different levels of brightness that are dim enough for nighttime use. The touch base receives positive feedback for its functionality, and customers find it easy to use, with one noting it's particularly suitable for elderly users. While some customers say it works very well, others report it doesn't work properly, and durability is a concern as customers mention the glass shade being fragile and prone to breaking.

authors_reviews.title: Bright and beautiful. Five stars plus!
authors_reviews.text: The lamp arrived very well packed. The whole lamp is encased in moulded polystyrene in its own box and then inside a bigger Amazon box. The original box looks very small but the lamp base is cleverly packed inside the shade. It’s very easy to assemble although if you have large hands the bulb might be a bit fiddly. I bought the recommended bulbs at the same time. It would have been nice to have a bulb included but as the price of the lamp was very reasonable I don’t mind. The good points are -1. The lamp is well made and looks more expensive than it is.2. The 3 levels of light are perfect. The lowest is a perfect night light. The next is easily bright enough to read by. The brightest is still not hard on the eyes, even with a glass shade.3. As it is a touch lamp there is no cord trailing over the bedside cabinet where a lot of lamps have an inline switch. There is also no struggling to reach a switch often located at the base of the bulb. I bought it as I have rheumatoid arthritis and my hands are basically useless at night. The lightest touch is all that is required.4. I think the lamp is a nice size. The shade in particular is slim whereas on a lot of lamps the shade can get in the way on a bedside cabinet, particularly if you have limited space which is often the case. I have taken a photo with a phone to show the scale.5. The clear shade is so much better than a lot of the fabric covered ones which seem to be on the bulk of bedside lights. It doesn’t dull the light so you don’t need a high wattage bulb. You don’t need to colour match it other than choosing the base.The few negative points are -1. The touch base is very sensitive. If you are heavy handed the light will just turn on then immediately off but it is not a real problem.2. The cord could have been a bit longer. Fortunately my sockets are exactly in the middle of my double bed. Even though my bedside cabinets are quite tall the lamp is still at least 18 inches from the edge of the cabinet.3. The shade is fine glass which looks so much better than plastic but makes it unsuitable for a child’s room. If you knocked or dropped the lamp it would certainly break.The negative points are very very minor and no problem. The lamp looks more expensive than it is. It’s a perfect size and doesn’t crowd the bedside cabinet. It’s so easy to operate and it’s nice to have 3 light levels. It is also a nice bright light which many of todays lamps are not. I would certainly recommend it and am planning on buying a second one.
authors_reviews.author: S D.

authors_reviews.title: High risk delivery due to fragility
authors_reviews.text: Love the light, ordered a pair, when they arrived one had a shattered glass shade (visible without taking out of box (which had a visible crush into the corner). The other light was fine & ticked all boxes for replacing a pair of 10yr old bedside lights.Did an Amazon return, refund & re-order one light. Just arrived & yep, shade in bits again. Difficult to blame seller as well wrapped in tissue & polystyrene but yet again the box showed crush marks. The box didn’t say ‘FRAGILE’ but not sure many delivery drivers would pay that much care even so.Very frustrated but will try for 3rd time lucky as we do like the light that was delivered in one piece.And TBF, lots of reviews say this is fragile glass.
